title: Silver Zoom Card: Designed for Transportation and Logistics Businesses
summary: The document describes the Silver Zoom Card for established transportation and logistics operators, requiring personal credit at/above $680 and business credit at/above 57. It lists a $74.50 annual membership, 10.0% recurring fuel price reduction at participating stations, 3.0% elevated rewards on sector spend, 1.0% on other eligible purchases, and a 0% APR fuel financing promo for the first year for eligible new customers.
